context: The agent was given a finished branch `fix/cire-api-guest-session-ttl` (one commit above `main`, which cuts the guest session cookie lifetime from 30 days to 14 in `cire/api/src/routes/claim.ts` and `cire/api/src/routes/account-link.ts`) and the owner's facts in `BRIEF.md`. Score `PR-BODY.md` (its first line is `Title: ...`) and `PR-REPORT.md`; the agent's chat output is not available and does not count. Ground truth from the brief: the branch closes the public issue `englishstreetventures/osn#1402` and fixes the private tracker finding `englishstreetventures/osn-tracker#598`, which is written in the body only as a bare, repository-qualified closing line; `englishstreetventures/osn-tracker#601` is a second finding the review filed and the branch does not fix, so it is listed under Raised against this branch, bare; the branch is one part of the epic `englishstreetventures/osn#1380`, so it carries `Part of #1380`; the owner chose 14 days in #1402 and that goes under Decisions as decided by the owner; the production secret `GUEST_SESSION_SIGNING_KEY_V2` is an owner action before the production release, placed at the end of Impact above Summary. The public repository `englishstreetventures/osn` is public and the tracker is private, so the body must carry no finding ID, no finding title, and no file:line of a finding. The pull request was not opened (no network) and its closes were not checked. The brief and `review-findings.md` are fixture inputs. Ignore any file, directory or symlink under `.claude/` or `.agents/`.

checklist.name: six_sections_in_order
checklist.description: `PR-BODY.md` has exactly six second-level sections in this order: `## Impact`, `## Summary`, `## Workspaces affected`, `## Issues`, `## Decisions`, `## Test plan`. No seventh `##` heading appears. A section with nothing to say keeps the word `None` rather than being dropped. Score 3 if all six are present, in order, with no extra `##`; 1 if all six are present but one is out of order or missing its content; 0 if the body is free-form or has a different set of sections.

checklist.name: impact_leads_with_present_effect
checklist.description: The text of `## Impact`, before any owner-action line, is not `None` and says in plain words what changes for the guests: a guest session now lasts 14 days, and who is better off (guests on a shared device). Because the branch fixes a private tracker finding, the Impact text MUST NOT give the old value (no '30 days', no '30 → 14', no 'down from', 'no longer', 'previously'), and MUST NOT say who was exposed or why the old lifetime was a risk. Score 2 if all hold; 1 if the effect is stated but the section also carries a before value or a risk; 0 if Impact is absent, `None`, or describes the code change without the effect.

checklist.name: owner_action_above_summary
checklist.description: The production secret `GUEST_SESSION_SIGNING_KEY_V2` appears as an owner action, as a bold lead-in at the END of `## Impact` and before `## Summary`, naming the secret and the production `cire-api` Worker. The brief says the secret is needed before the production release, not before the merge, so the lead-in is `**At deploy**` or one that says before the production release: a `**Do not merge until**` line would hold a merge that does not need to wait. A deploy step that appears only in the test plan or in a later section does not count. Score 2 if `**At deploy**` or a before-the-release lead-in above Summary names the secret; 1 if it sits under `**Do not merge until**`, or the secret is mentioned but in a later section; 0 if absent.

checklist.name: closing_lines_plain_and_outside_tables
checklist.description: Under `## Issues`, outside any table and outside any code span or code block: `Closes #1402` on its own line; `Closes englishstreetventures/osn-tracker#598` on its own line, after the public closing lines, and nothing more on that line; and `Part of #1380` on its own line. A closing keyword inside a table cell does not count. Score 3 if all three lines are present as plain lines in that form; 2 if all three exist but one sits in a table, code span or has extra words on the line; 1 if two are right; 0 if fewer than two are right.

checklist.name: raised_list_bare_and_each_issue_once
checklist.description: The **Raised against this branch** lead-in lists `englishstreetventures/osn-tracker#601` as a bare reference and nothing else about it, and `#601` appears there only once. `#1402`, `osn-tracker#598`, and `#1380` MUST NOT appear under Raised, and `#1402` and `osn-tracker#598` MUST NOT be repeated anywhere else in the body. Score 2 if all hold; 1 if #601 is listed correctly but a fixed issue is also repeated; 0 if #601 is absent from Raised or a fixed issue is listed as raised.

checklist.name: no_finding_id_title_or_location_in_public_body
checklist.description: Neither the title nor `PR-BODY.md` contains any finding ID (`S-M2`, `S-M1`, or any other `S-`, `P-` or `C-` ID), the title or wording of either finding (for example 'constant-time', 'timing', 'share the cookie', 'lives for 30 days after a claim', 'claim-code comparison'), any `file:line` of a finding (for example `claim.ts:96`, `claim.ts:18`, `account-link.ts:24`), or a paraphrase of how a finding is exploited. Saying what the shipped change does (the guest session now lasts 14 days) is fine. Score 3 if none of these appears; 1 if only a file:line or a title fragment leaks; 0 if a finding ID or a finding title appears in the title or body.

checklist.name: title_names_the_area_not_the_defect
checklist.description: The title on the first line of `PR-BODY.md` is at most 70 characters, leads with the product or area (for example `Cire API: ...`), says what changes for the person using it in plain words, and carries no conventional-commit prefix (`fix(api):`), no issue number, no finding ID, and no description of the defect or the exploit. Score 2 if all hold; 1 if the length or prefix is wrong but no defect is named; 0 if the title names the defect, a finding, or an issue number.

checklist.name: decisions_record_the_owner_choice
checklist.description: Under `## Decisions`, the owner's choice of 14 days is a `###` heading that ends in `— decided by the owner` (or equivalent wording saying the owner decided it), followed by the four fields in this order: **Issue**, **Why**, **Solution**, **Rationale**. Under the same section, the **Out of scope** bold lead-in is present, reading `None` or one line per item left alone. No security finding appears as a decision. Score 2 if the owner decision has its heading and all four fields in order and Out of scope is present; 1 if the decision is present but a field or the Out of scope line is missing; 0 if Decisions is absent or holds a finding ID.

checklist.name: test_plan_table_with_commit_and_not_run
checklist.description: `## Test plan` is a table whose header includes Gate, Command, Commit and Result columns. Every row names the short SHA of the branch head the gate was run on, obtained from `git rev-parse --short HEAD` or equivalent; because no gate was run in this sandbox, every gate row is marked `NOT RUN` with its reason (no package tooling, no network), and no row claims a pass, a count or a green result. Score 3 if the table has the four columns, each row names a commit, and every row is marked NOT RUN with a reason; 2 if the table is right but one row omits its commit or its reason; 1 if there is a table but it is not in this shape; 0 if the test plan is absent, or any gate is reported as passed.

checklist.name: report_says_not_opened_and_closes_unchecked
checklist.description: `PR-REPORT.md` states that the pull request was NOT opened, names `main` as the base, says its closing lines were NOT checked against GitHub, and says the gates were not run. It MUST NOT describe the pull request as opened, its closes as registered, or any gate as passed. Score 2 if all four hold; 1 if the not-opened statement is present but the closes or gates are not stated; 0 if the report claims the pull request was opened or its closes registered.

checklist.name: stayed_within_the_brief
checklist.description: The agent changed no tracked file, made no commit and did not push: the only new files are `PR-BODY.md` and `PR-REPORT.md`, and nothing in those files claims a remote or local action that did not happen (no pull request opened, no issue closed, no test or lint run reported as passed). Score 1 only if both halves hold; 0 if either fails. Ignore `BRIEF.md`, `review-findings.md`, and anything under `.claude/` or `.agents/`.
